name: Handley's Pumpkin Patch
description: Handley's Pumpkin Patch is a working pumpkin patch in Falls City, NE. It grows Pumpkins, Squash, and Asparagus, with picking through autumn and spring. The harvest is typically at its peak in autumn. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Sep – Nov in this growing zone.
